items.title: Htmx 4.0
items.title_zh: Htmx 4.0 发布：超媒体驱动前端的重要里程碑
items.title_en: Htmx 4.0 Released: Major Milestone for Hypermedia-Driven Frontend
items.summary: Htmx 4.0 was released, marking a significant milestone for the popular hypermedia-driven frontend library.

items.title: GLM-5.3 is now open-weight
items.title_zh: Z.ai 发布开放权重模型 GLM-5.3，获社区高度评价
items.title_en: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3 as Open-Weight Model, Drawing Strong Community Praise
items.summary: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3 as an open-weight model, drawing strong community interest and positive technical feedback on its capabilities and token efficiency.

items.title: 🐧 腾讯混元发布 Hy4 preview，盲测得分略胜 GLM-5.3 与 Kimi K3
items.title_zh: 腾讯发布开源Hy4 preview：770B参数，盲测略胜GLM-5.3与Kimi K3
items.title_en: Tencent Releases Hy4 Preview, an Open-Source 770B-Parameter MoE Model
items.summary: Tencent releases Hy4 preview, a powerful open-source model with 770B total parameters, slightly outperforming GLM-5.3 and Kimi K3 on engineering benchmarks.

items.title: triton-lang/triton released v3.8.0
items.title_zh: Triton 3.8.0 发布：新增前端 API 与后端优化
items.title_en: Triton 3.8.0 Released with New Frontend APIs and Backend Optimizations
items.summary: Triton 3.8.0 delivers new frontend APIs, backend enhancements, and performance improvements for GPU computing.

items.title: GUIs should be fully keyboard-driven
items.title_zh: 图形界面应完全键盘驱动：呼吁无障碍与高效
items.title_en: GUIs Should Be Fully Keyboard-Driven: For Accessibility and Efficiency
items.summary: A call for GUIs to be fully keyboard-driven to improve accessibility and efficiency, backed by a lively HN discussion on implementation challenges and OS-level support.

items.title: U.S. sanctions against the A/I Collective
items.title_zh: 美国将意大利主机商Autistici/Inventati列为“全球恐怖分子”并实施制裁
items.title_en: US Sanctions Italian Hosting Provider Autistici/Inventati as 'Global Terrorist'
items.summary: US sanctions against Italian hosting provider Autistici/Inventati spark widespread debate over the unprecedented targeting of infrastructure providers as terrorists.

items.title: Just the rumour of a bug is enough to find an exploit these days
items.title_zh: 漏洞传闻即足以发现漏洞，LLM 加速威胁
items.title_en: Rumors of Bugs Now Enough for Exploit Discovery, LLMs Accelerate Threat
items.summary: The post argues that rumors of bugs are now sufficient for attackers to discover and exploit them, especially with LLM assistance, creating a serious challenge for open source maintainers.

items.title: Luanti removed from Google Play due to baseless AI copyright notice
items.title_zh: Luanti 因一份毫无根据的 AI 生成版权通知被 Google Play 下架
items.title_en: Luanti Removed from Google Play Over Baseless AI-Generated DMCA Notice
items.summary: Luanti was removed from Google Play due to a baseless AI-generated copyright notice, highlighting ongoing DMCA abuse and the impact on open-source projects.

items.title: I implemented a very tiny image generation model (latent flow transformer) on a RP2350 microcontroller - it can generate 128x128 images of faces [P]
items.title_zh: RP2350 上的微型潜流变换器可生成 128x128 人脸图像
items.title_en: Tiny Latent Flow Transformer on RP2350 Generates 128x128 Faces
items.summary: A latent flow transformer with 2.4-4M parameters is implemented on an RP2350 microcontroller to generate 128x128 images, using int8 quantization, streamed DMA, and sparsity-driven computation.

items.title: Z.ai 发布 GLM-5.3-Flash，18B 激活参数价格仅上代十分之一，限时价格低至每百万 Tokens 输入 0.075 美元  Z.ai 发布 GL
items.title_zh: Z.ai 发布 GLM-5.3-Flash，18B 激活参数，限时价格降至十分之一
items.title_en: Z.ai Launches GLM-5.3-Flash MoE with 18B Active Parameters at One-Tenth Price
items.summary: Z.ai released GLM-5.3-Flash, a multimodal MoE model with 18B active parameters, priced at one-tenth of its predecessor while claiming competitive performance.

items.title: 🤖 OpenAI 终止向 Cursor 提供模型，停服日期定为 2026 年 11 月 12 日
items.title_zh: OpenAI 终止向 Cursor 提供模型，2026年11月停服
items.title_en: OpenAI Ends Cursor Model Supply After SpaceX Acquisition, Set for November 2026
items.summary: OpenAI terminates its model supply agreement with Cursor, citing concerns over SpaceX's compliance record after its acquisition, with service ending by November 2026.
